subject: maths
title: Primary 1 Addition and Subtraction within 20
seo_title: P1 Addition and Subtraction within 20 Worksheets: Free Primary 1 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Use of +, − and =; adding more than two 1-digit numbers; mental calculation within 20
meta_desc: Free P1 maths practice: add and subtract within 20, make 10 to add, add three numbers and solve word problems. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: To add, put groups together. To subtract, take some away.
body_html:
Add: put groups together

To add, put two groups together. Then find how many in all. The sign + means add. The sign = means is equal to.

To count on, start at the bigger number. Do not say it again. For 5 + 3, say 6, 7, 8.

Subtract: take away

To subtract, start with a group. Take some away. Count what is left. The sign − means take away.

Example

What is 14 − 6?

14 − 4 = 10. Take away 2 more. 10 − 2 = 8.

Answer: 8

Make 10 to add

Adding to 10 is easy. So split the second number. Use one part to make 10.

Example

What is 9 + 6?

9 + 1 = 10. 5 is left. 10 + 5 = 15.

Answer: 15

Add three numbers

Add two numbers first. Then add the third. Look for two numbers that make 10.

Example

What is 3 + 5 + 7?

3 + 7 = 10. Then 10 + 5 = 15.

Answer: 15

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
6 + 3 = 8 (saying 6, 7, 8)Do not say the start number. Say 7, 8, 9. So 6 + 3 = 9.
12 − 5 = 17That adds. “Take away” means subtract. 12 − 5 = 7.
8 + 5 = 10 + 5 = 152 of the 5 made the 10. Only 3 are left. 8 + 5 = 13.
2 + 8 + 5 = 10Add all three numbers. 10 + 5 = 15.

faq.q: What is taught in P1 addition and subtraction?
faq.a: In Primary 1, students use the signs +, − and = and add and subtract within 20 in their heads. They also add three 1-digit numbers and solve simple word problems.

faq.q: How do I teach my child to make 10 to add?
faq.a: Split the smaller number so one part fills up 10. For 8 + 5, split 5 into 2 and 3: 8 + 2 = 10, and 10 + 3 = 13.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake in P1 addition?
faq.a: When counting on, many children say the start number again, so 6 + 3 becomes “6, 7, 8” and the answer is 1 too small. Have them start counting from the next number: 7, 8, 9.

faq.q: Is this in the MOE Primary 1 maths syllabus?
faq.a: Yes. Addition and subtraction within 20, the signs +, − and =, and adding three 1-digit numbers are part of Number and Algebra in the MOE 2021 Primary 1 syllabus.

items.q: 3 + 6 = 9. What is 6 + 3?

items.q: In 2 + 5 = 7, what does + mean?
items.e: The + sign means add. We put 2 and 5 together to get 7.
The = sign means is equal to. 4 + 4 is the same as 8.

items.q: What is the missing part?
items.e: Think: 4 + ? = 9. 4 + 5 = 9. So the missing part is 5.
